derivation: by simpa [ht.ne_empty] using (prod_eq_prod_iff (s := s) (t := t) (s₁ := s₁) (t₁ := t))
explanation: The general theorem characterizes equality of two product sets. Taking their second factors to be the same nonempty set t simplifies its right-hand side to s = s₁. The target proof already uses Set.prod_eq_prod_iff.
